entries.title: Scaling Git at OpenAI
entries.summary: How OpenAI built Pando, a Git-compatible backend designed for the scale of development that Codex makes possible.

entries.title: Introducing the Grid Protectors Program
entries.summary: OpenAI’s Grid Protectors Program will work with utilities to help future compute campuses support grid reliability and protect consumer electricity costs.

entries.title: LifeVal
entries.summary: Introducing LifeVal, a benchmark measuring how well AI helps people complete everyday tasks, from finding childcare to managing finances and government paperwork.

entries.title: Qodo builds context into AI code review with Codex
entries.summary: Qodo brings company knowledge and coding standards into Codex, helping developers catch P0 issues across repositories before opening a pull request.

entries.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
entries.summary: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal to help website operators communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers.

entries.title: Community safety report and new protections for teens
entries.summary: OpenAI is strengthening violence prevention in ChatGPT with expanded safeguards, earlier interventions, and a new commitment to public safety reporting.

entries.title: Fair use benefits everyone
entries.summary: OpenAI shares excerpts from court briefs by creators, academics, accessibility advocates, and legal experts, among others, on how fair use supports AI training and innovation.

entries.title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
entries.summary: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec outlines five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.

entries.title: How we detect frontier model misalignment
entries.summary: OpenAI uses layered monitoring to detect frontier model misalignment and unauthorized agent behavior so responders can intervene before incidents escalate.

entries.title: How Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence
entries.summary: Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence with OpenAI. Lawyers review grouped documents, summaries, and reports before advising clients.
